title: Sardine and White Bean Salad

ingredients.name: sardines packed in olive oil (3.75 oz can)

steps: Drain and rinse the beans. Halve the tomatoes, shred the red cabbage finely, slice the red onion thinly, and chop the parsley.
Whisk the olive oil, the juice of both lemons, the grated garlic, the black pepper, and the sea salt into a dressing.
Toss the beans, tomatoes, cabbage, onion, and parsley with most of the dressing and let them sit 10 minutes.
Fold the arugula through at the last moment so it stays crisp.
Top with the drained sardines and spoon the remaining dressing over them.
goldenRuleCallouts: The second fatty-fish meal of the week; sardines bring omega-3s with no cooking at all.
Naturally gluten-free — serve it as a bowl rather than on toast to keep it that way.
